value: Dutch Civil Code Book 7, Title 4 (Huur), including the rules on rent, deposit and termination.
The deposit may be at most twice the base rent (art. 7:261b BW).

Landlord must return the deposit within 14 days after the end of the tenancy; within 30 days where it is set off against proven damage or unpaid rent and service costs, with a written itemised statement (art. 7:261b BW).

Dwellings valued up to 143 points (social) and 144 to 186 points (mid-rent) have a maximum rent; from 187 points a self-contained dwelling is free-sector. For contracts starting on or after 1 January 2026 the mid-rent range is a base rent from EUR 932.93 to EUR 1,228.07 per month.
